summary: This Dockerfile creates a PHP web server image starting from an official PHP image with Apache. It installs and enables MySQL-related extensions so PHP can connect to and work with MySQL databases.

explanations.1: ARG creates a build-time variable that can be overridden when building the image; it defaults to PHP 8.3 with Apache if not specified.
explanations.3: This uses the PHP_VERSION variable to pull a specific PHP base image, falling back to 'latest' if the variable wasn't set.
explanations.5: The 'set -e -x' flags make the shell exit immediately on any error and print each command before running it, which helps catch problems during the build.
explanations.6: docker-php-ext-install compiles and installs the three MySQL PHP extensions (mysqli, pdo, pdo_mysql), then docker-php-ext-enable activates the pdo_mysql extension so it's loaded when PHP runs.
